_instructions_for_claude: Build a responsive, elegant event website for the Harvesters Globe Ologolo Workers Ball 2026 using this theme specification. Match the mood of the event flyer: a dark, cinematic gala night lit by a single warm golden spotlight. Use the colors, typography, imagery direction, components and content below. Keep it mobile-first, since most guests will open it from WhatsApp or Instagram links.

event.name: Workers Ball 2026
tagline_suggestions: An evening of light, elegance and celebration
Celebrating the workers who light up our Globe
event.dress_code_suggestion: Black tie / formal gala attire (gold accents encouraged)

brand_mood.description: Near-black backgrounds with a warm amber glow falling from a single overhead spotlight. Silhouetted couple in formal wear (tuxedo and satin gown). Huge bold white headline text overlapping the figures, with a faint oversized watermark word behind. Gold and bright yellow accents for dates and highlights. Soft bokeh and blurred banquet tables suggest a ballroom.
avoid: thin, light-weight body-only typography for headlines

display_headline.use_for: The giant 'GLOBE' headline and hero titles

kicker.use_for: 'LIGHT OF' label above the headline, section eyebrows
kicker.style_note: Sits on a dark banner strip that fades to transparent at both ends (see gradients.kicker_banner)

condensed_info.use_for: Date, time, venue, countdown numbers, section headings
condensed_info.note: On the flyer, '22ND' is large and near-white, while 'NOV. 2026', '4PM' and the venue are in bright yellow

elegant_accent.use_for: Optional script-like or serif touches: quotes, 'An evening of elegance', RSVP intro

imagery.flyer_reference: Use the original event flyer as the hero/OG image if provided
imagery.hero: A silhouetted couple in formal wear (man in a three-piece suit, woman in a satin strapless gown) standing under a single warm overhead spotlight on a dark, reflective stage floor
imagery.secondary: Blurred gala banquet tables with gold chiavari chairs, white linen, candles and glassware in the foreground, shot with shallow depth of field
treatment: Heavy vignette to near-black at the edges
Light haze or fog in the spotlight beam
Subtle halftone or film-grain texture overlay (opacity ~0.06)

icons.style: Simple line icons in accent yellow (#F7D046)

layout.grid: Asymmetric editorial layout; event details anchored bottom-left as on the flyer
hero_composition: 'WORKERS BALL 2026' oval pill badge top-right with a thin gold outline
Spotlight cone falling from the top centre
Huge faint 'LUMINA' watermark behind, repeated on two lines
'LIGHT OF' kicker on a dark banner strip, then giant white 'GLOBE' headline overlapping the silhouettes
Date, time and venue stacked bottom-left with yellow icons
Primary RSVP button below the details

card.hover: Border brightens to #D4A445 and the card lifts slightly

components.divider: 1px gold line fading to transparent at both ends, with a small diamond or star in the centre

countdown.boxes: Card style with a gold top border

effects_and_motion.spotlight_glow: Slow pulsing opacity (0.85 to 1) on the spotlight gradient, ~6s ease-in-out infinite
effects_and_motion.particles: Few floating golden dust or bokeh particles drifting slowly upward in the hero
effects_and_motion.text_reveal: Headline fades and scales in from 1.05 to 1, kicker slides down
effects_and_motion.grain: Fixed SVG noise overlay at ~5% opacity

suggested_pages_or_sections.content: Theme title, badge, date, time, venue, RSVP button, countdown
About the Workers Ball and the 'Light of Globe / Lumina' theme
Evening schedule: arrival & red carpet, opening prayer, dinner, awards & recognition, entertainment, dance, closing
Formal / black tie with gold accents; style inspiration images
RSVP form: full name, department/unit, phone, email, attending with partner (yes/no), dietary needs
Harvesters Globe Ologolo, embedded map, directions and parking notes
Photo gallery placeholder for after the event
Harvesters International Christian Centre, Globe Ologolo; social links; contact

accessibility.contrast: Keep body text at #E8DCC4 or brighter on dark surfaces; never put gold body text on bronze
